For a complete cross-system audit on the SME credit-risk invoice warehouse (small/micro/medium enterprises), perform an
INNER JOIN across nch___sales_invoices, nch___input_invoices, nch___company_info on their natural keys
(s."Enterprise Code" = i."Enterprise Code" = c."Enterprise Code"). Do NOT apply any WHERE filter and do NOT add

inspection. Return all joined rows. The full SQLite database is

retain all rows):

  FROM nch___sales_invoices s INNER JOIN nch___input_invoices i ON i."Enterprise Code" = s."Enterprise Code" INNER JOIN nch___company_info c ON c."Enterprise Code" = s."Enterprise Code";
